outcome: conception rate according to IUA severity
reproductive methods for conception (spontaneous conception, ovulation induction, intrauterine insemination, in-vitro fertilization with/without ICSI)
pregnancy outcomes (ectopic pregnancy, miscarriage, live birth events)
cohort: 41 infertile women with Asherman syndrome (mean age 32.2 years) who underwent hysteroscopic adhesiolysis.
finding: The spontaneous cumulative conception rate following hysteroscopic adhesiolysis was significantly higher in patients with minimal intrauterine adhesions compared to those with moderate and severe adhesions.
